methodology: Warm in-process calls timed by the site matrix harnesses; median per call after symmetric 1.5×IQR outlier filtering, raw samples and exclusions retained. Every timed checksum and the printed output are verified against the instruction engine. Native samples execute 32 checked calls in one ELF process and divide by 32, amortizing one process startup per sample; other targets exclude process startup. Compilation is excluded. Host gate: every measured job runs pinned (inherited affinity, no wrapper) to one logical CPU of the quietest core and is repeated unless that CPU kept its clock within 3% of the job median (10th to 90th percentile), the median reached 95% of the clock calibrated at start, and the hyperthread sibling was busy at most 15% of the job; Go runs with GOMAXPROCS=1 on that CPU. Rejected attempts are retained with their observations.

sample_statistics.rule: Tukey 1.5×IQR fences; linearly interpolated inclusive quartiles; both tails; raw samples retained
